form.label: Zscaler ZIA NSS - Overview
form.description: Fixture-backed overview for Zscaler Internet Access NSS web and firewall JSON relay events. Panels use fields proven by synthetic-equivalent fixtures plus Splunk JSON/search-time knowledge; this dashboard is not replay/read-back validation.

search.query: index IN (netproxy,netfw) sourcetype IN ("zscaler:zia:web","zscaler:zia:firewall") host=$host_tok$ | stats count

index IN (netproxy,netfw) sourcetype IN ("zscaler:zia:web","zscaler:zia:firewall") host=$host_tok$ | eval zia_action=lower(coalesce(action,'event.action')) | search zia_action IN ("drop","block","blocked","deny","denied") | stats count
index=netproxy sourcetype="zscaler:zia:web" host=$host_tok$ (severity=* OR 'event.threatseverity'=*) | stats count
index IN (netproxy,netfw) sourcetype IN ("zscaler:zia:web","zscaler:zia:firewall") host=$host_tok$ | timechart count by sourcetype
index IN (netproxy,netfw) sourcetype IN ("zscaler:zia:web","zscaler:zia:firewall") host=$host_tok$ | stats count by index sourcetype | sort -count

index IN (netproxy,netfw) sourcetype IN ("zscaler:zia:web","zscaler:zia:firewall") host=$host_tok$ | eval zia_action=coalesce(action,'event.action') | stats count by zia_action | sort -count | head 20

index IN (netproxy,netfw) sourcetype IN ("zscaler:zia:web","zscaler:zia:firewall") host=$host_tok$ | eval zia_user=coalesce(user,'event.login','event.user') | stats count by zia_user | sort -count | head 20

index IN (netproxy,netfw) sourcetype IN ("zscaler:zia:web","zscaler:zia:firewall") host=$host_tok$ | eval zia_src=coalesce(src_ip,src,'event.cltip','event.csip') | stats count by zia_src | sort -count | head 20

index=netproxy sourcetype="zscaler:zia:web" host=$host_tok$ | eval zia_url_host=coalesce(url_host,'event.host'), zia_app=coalesce(app,'event.appname'), zia_severity=coalesce(severity,'event.threatseverity'), zia_record=coalesce('event.recordid',recordid), zia_reason='event.reason', zia_method='event.reqmethod', zia_response='event.respcode' | table _time host user src_ip dest_ip zia_url_host zia_method zia_response action zia_reason zia_severity zia_app zia_record 'event.sc4s_marker' | sort -_time | head 100

index=netfw sourcetype="zscaler:zia:firewall" host=$host_tok$ | eval zia_record=coalesce('event.recordid',recordid), zia_rule=coalesce(rule,'event.rulelabel'), zia_app=coalesce(app,'event.nwapp'), zia_dest_country='event.destcountry' | table _time host user src_ip dest_ip dest_port transport action zia_rule zia_app zia_dest_country 'event.durationms' 'event.inbytes' 'event.outbytes' zia_record 'event.sc4s_marker' | sort -_time | head 100

index IN (netproxy,netfw) sourcetype IN ("zscaler:zia:web","zscaler:zia:firewall") host=$host_tok$ | eval zia_dest=coalesce(dest,dest_ip,'event.serverip','event.cdip'), zia_app=coalesce(app,'event.appname','event.nwapp','event.nwsvc'), zia_rule=coalesce(rule,'event.rulelabel') | stats count by sourcetype zia_dest dest_port transport zia_app zia_rule action | sort -count | head 50

index IN (netproxy,netfw) sourcetype IN ("zscaler:zia:web","zscaler:zia:firewall") host=$host_tok$ | stats count dc('event.sc4s_marker') as fixture_markers min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by index sourcetype source host vendor product | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | sort -count

index IN (netproxy,netfw) sourcetype IN ("zscaler:zia:web","zscaler:zia:firewall") host=$host_tok$ | table _time index sourcetype source host vendor product user src src_ip dest dest_ip dest_port transport action severity app rule url_host 'event.recordid' 'event.sc4s_marker' _raw | sort -_time | head 50
